scientific_integrity: Proved analytically by exact matrix-entry factorization and an exit-rate diagonal bound. The standalone rational verifier provides supplementary checks, not an infinite proof. Bibliographic originality is qualified by an inaccessible potentially relevant primary full text.
scientific_limitations: Completed-step positivity for fixed finite linear Markov generators only; no guarantee of intermediate-stage positivity, nonlinear SSP stability, or accuracy at the largest step; priority risk from unavailable historical full text.
title: Sharp graph-local positivity horizons and an SSP-equality motif for second-order Markov Runge–Kutta
